reason: A DSH Web UI plugin focused on replacing the sidebar with a Codex-style workspace and conversation navigator, including search, turn navigation, and related session controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 Codex 风格的侧边栏、工作区与会话树、全局搜索和当前会话回合导航。
summaries.en: Provides a Codex-style DSH Web sidebar with workspace and conversation navigation, global search, and turn navigation for the current session.

capabilities: Replaces the host web sidebar through a public sidebar slot
Displays and navigates workspaces and conversations
Provides user-triggered conversation actions including rename, archive, fork, copy, and delete
Stores pinned and unread state in browser localStorage
Can expose companion-plugin installation and update controls in Settings
